title: The Summer I Discovered Another World
logline: In Grade Seven, a first visit to grandfather's countryside becomes a discovery of rain, land, gojo nights, fresh milk—and a way of seeing the world that never leaves.
audience: Family who know this grandfather's place, and friends who grew up only in the city—watching on a phone, remembering how a visit can change you.
intent: Feel the wonder of that first countryside summer—and understand that the most beautiful journeys can be the ones that take us back to where we learned to see.
